messages:
amanda (docs): Quick sync 1 PR #6799 updates quota + rate-limit examples for SDKv6. I swapped header names to the new product term but want a quick sanity check on wording and the dashboard link. https://confluence.redwood/internal/docs/quota-guide
raj (eng): Which header did you use? We standardized last month but left a legacy alias.
amanda (docs): Using `x-rw-usage-plan` in all examples. The old docs used `x-rw-quota`. Sample cURL in the PR:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "x-rw-usage-plan: pro" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage
```
luisa (pm): Good. Please add a single-line migration note: "Legacy header `x-rw-quota` maps to `x-rw-usage-plan`."
Also, prefer the term "grace credits" in UX copy; internal teams may say "burst credits" but user docs should use grace credits.
matt (data): Also call out meter name in the dashboard link. I noticed the panel id is `plan-usage-42` and metric `usage_plan`. Better to reference both so readers can find it.
amanda (docs): Will do. Plan to add: 1) migration note, 2) small python snippet, 3) dashboard URL with panel id and metric name. Draft python snippet below:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="${TOKEN}")
c.headers.update({"x-rw-usage-plan": "pro"})
resp = c.get("/v1/usage")
print(resp.json())
```
raj (eng): +1 for header change. One nit: in the quota explanation, call out that grace credits are consumed prior to plan quota and do not reset until billing cycle boundary. Keep it short.
amanda (docs): Adding that sentence. @deploy-bot can you run docs-ci on the branch after I push?
deploy-bot: docs-ci: lint & build started for PR #6799
raj (eng): I pushed a tiny commit to swap the dashboard URL to include panel `plan-usage-42` and added a parenthetical metric name.
matt (data): I'll add a 1-line JS snippet for fetch in a follow-up commit.
amanda (docs): Thanks all 1 merging once CI green and then I'll backfill redirects for the old link.
deploy-bot: docs-ci: lint & build passed ✅
amanda (docs): Merged PR #6799. Closing thread.
